expectations.text: States WordPress.org does not permit temporary closure of a plugin
expectations.evidence: "Closing is meant to be permanent, not a pause."

expectations.text: Explains that author-requested closure is meant to be permanent and reopening requires a full current standards and security review
expectations.evidence: "Reopening needs a full review against current standards"

expectations.text: Notes a plugin above 10,000 users cannot be closed by the author from the Advanced tab and needs an email to the Plugins Team
expectations.evidence: "Above 10,000† users, closing needs a written request to the Plugins Team."

expectations.text: Recommends shipping the fixed version as the response instead of closing
expectations.evidence: "Do not close the plugin. Ship 3.4.2 with the fix."

expectations.text: Explains that a blocked release is not offered as an update while the previous distributed version keeps being served and the plugin stays open
expectations.evidence: "A high score blocks that version, and sites keep the previous one"; "The listing stays up"

expectations.text: Recommends fixing the findings and shipping a new version rather than waiting on a false-positive appeal
expectations.evidence: "A rewrite is faster than an appeal."; "If 3.4.2 is blocked, fix the findings and ship 3.4.3. Don't wait on a reply."

expectations.text: Says a false-positive reply to the block email is possible but slower
expectations.evidence: "Reply to the email only for a clear false positive, and expect the reply to be slower than a new release."

expectations.text: Resets the one-hour target: every release waits a cooldown (about 6 hours) during an automated security review before distribution
expectations.evidence: "Every release waits a 6-hour† cooldown"; "The directory cannot put a fix on customer sites within the hour"

expectations.text: Gives the release mechanics: bump Version, update Stable tag, commit trunk and copy to a new tag

expectations.text: Mentions that the new release goes through the same automated review and could be blocked again

expectations.text: Marks the cooldown duration as a figure to verify
